C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to approve a donation to Fedde Academy.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, presented the staff report.

  Denise Macias, Principal, Fedde Academy, spoke.

  Councilmember Vargas spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Roa spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, to approve a
  $5,000 donation to Fedde Academy.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; De Paula, Farfan, Vargas, Roa, Del Rio
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

  625, amending Chapter 6.28 of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code regarding Firework

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, presented the staff report.

  Councilmember De Paula spoke.

  A motion was made by Mayor Pro Tem Roa, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, to approve
  recommendation.

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced dates for upcoming events:
April 30 ­ pet vaccinations; May 16 ­ Second Annual Teen Summit; May 22 ­ Memorial Day Event; and
announced hours for the Teen Center and tutoring service.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a Neighborhood Safety Meeting will be held on
May 6; and a Catalytic Converter Engraving Event on May 16.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, thanked everyone who attended the Earth Day Event; and
provided an update on the upcoming Carson Street Improvement Project.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember De Paula thanked residents and schools for participating in the parade; and extended
condolences to the Catholic community for the passing away of Father Larry Darnell, St. Peter Chanel
Catholic Church.

Mayor Del Rio thanked staff and everyone who participated in the parade and carnival

Councilmember Vargas complimented staff for the parade and carnival.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 6:50 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
